text:
maria: Heads-up — planning a config-gate rollout for per-tenant batching tonight at 22:00 UTC. Need an owner for the switch and smoke checks. Safe-defaults must be enforced (global fallbacks). Who's available? :hourglass:

dave: I can own the deploy and watch the first 30m. Will be on call from the green room.

sara: I can run the smoke scripts and monitor Dashboards (latency / errors / token burn). Smoke runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.internal/runbooks/smoke-per-tenant-batching

jen: Quick Q — can we make initial canary at tenant-level at 5%? Also want rate-limit safe-default at 1r/s per tenant during canary. Need rollback command documented.

maria: Yes — plan is tenant-level canary (EU first). Safe-defaults in config service: tenant_rate_limit=1, batching_enabled=false (fallback). Rollback CLI:
```
redwoodctl config set per_tenant_batching off --env=prod --reason="rollback"
```
deploy-bot: Scheduled window created: 22:00 UTC. Reminder set for 30m prior.

alan: Who actually triggers the toggle? dave or me? Also who's the secondary if dave is paged?

dave: I'll trigger the toggle and open canary to 5% then watch metrics. If healthy at 15m, bump to 25%. Alan, can you be secondary rollback?

alan: Yep, I'll be on rotation and ready to run rollback if needed.

priya: Smoke checklist to confirm:
1) curl health endpoints for a handful of EU tenants
2) verify prefix/KV cache hitrate doesn't drop >5%
3) monitor 95th/99th gen latency for /v1/generate route
4) confirm no increase in 5xxs or auth failures
5) check cost/token variance (should be steady)
Curl snip for health check:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.prod/health?tenant=eu-123
```

maria: Good checklist. If any regression, run the rollback CLI above, post reason, and ping #eng-oncall + @dave + @alan. Ops runbook: https://confluence.redwood.internal/ops/config-rollback

jen: One more — region order? You said EU first, then global. Do we need to exclude any high-traffic tenants from the 5% canary?

dave: We'll exclude top100 tenants for the 5% phase, add them back at 25% only after green. I'll attach the exclusion list 15m before.

maria: Summary: owner=dave, smoke=sara, secondary=alan, time=22:00 UTC, scope=EU tenants (top100 excluded), canary progression=5%->25%, safe-defaults enforced, rollback CLI as above. I'll send a calendar invite and post a 30m reminder here. :white_check_mark:

sara: ack

dave: ack

deploy-bot: Reminder posted 30m before window. Good luck! :rocket:
